decisions.reason: The transactional email service is the firm's flagship and builds directly on its core messaging expertise and proprietary infrastructure, so the firm can read its results and keep improving it.
Managed capture extends the firm's electronic document workflow know-how, has a documented customer reference, and fits its digital process direction, so it can be refined internally.
Email-fax conversion rests on the firm's long-standing fax and email messaging base and serves regulated customers who still need these channels.
The fax delivery optimization feature is a low-cost add-on to the firm's established fax infrastructure and draws on deep related knowledge, even though fax demand is slowly declining.
Sandbox threat protection builds on the firm's email security expertise and fits its security-focused portfolio, unlike the dropped multi-engine scanner, so the firm can assimilate and improve it.
